grammar.title: Quy tắc thêm đuôi -ed (quá khứ đơn)
grammar.html:
• Thường thêm ed: play → played, cook → cooked
  • Động từ tận cùng bằng e chỉ thêm d: like → liked
  • Động từ một âm tiết tận cùng “1 phụ âm + 1 nguyên âm + 1 phụ âm” thì gấp đôi phụ âm: stop → stopped
  • Tận cùng “phụ âm + y” đổi y thành i rồi thêm ed: study → studied
  • Động từ bất quy tắc phải học thuộc: go → went, take → took, buy → bought, eat → ate, swim → swam

grammar.title: Hỏi ai đó đã làm việc gì (Yes/No)
grammar.html:
Did + S + V? – Yes, S + did. / No, S + didn’t.

  • Did you swim yesterday? – Yes, I did.
  • Did she walk on the beach last Sunday? – No, she didn’t.
  • Did they collect seashells last weekend? – Yes, they did.

grammar.title: Hỏi ai đó đã làm gì ở đâu
grammar.html:
What did + S + do + in + địa điểm? – S + V-ed.

  • What did you do in Nha Trang? – I ate seafood.
  • What did they do in Ha Long Bay? – They took a boat trip.
  • What did he do in Nha Trang? – He took photos.

grammar.title: Hỏi về tần suất
grammar.html:
How often does he/she + V? – He/She + V(s/es) + tần suất.

  • How often does he drink orange juice? – He drinks orange juice three times a week.
  • How often does she eat vegetables? – She eats vegetables every day.

💡 once a week = 1 lần/tuần · twice a week = 2 lần/tuần · three times a week = 3 lần/tuần · every day = mỗi ngày.

exercises.passage: There are four seasons in Viet Nam. Spring is the first season of the year. It starts in February and ends in April. The weather is warm and sunny. Flowers bloom and trees grow new leaves. Summer is the hottest season. It lasts from May to August. The days are long and hot. It often rains a lot, especially in the afternoons. Autumn is also called fall. It comes after summer, from September to November. The weather becomes cooler and the leaves on the trees change color. Winter is the coldest season. It starts in December and ends in January. The days are short and the nights are long. It can be quite cold in the north of Vietnam, but in the south, it’s still warm.

grammar.title: Hỏi bạn nghĩ gì về một địa điểm
grammar.html:
What do you think of + địa điểm? – I think it’s / they’re + tính từ.

  • What do you think of Ban Gioc Waterfall? – I think it’s peaceful.

grammar.title: Hỏi ai đó nghĩ gì về một địa điểm
grammar.html:
What does he/she think of + địa điểm? – He/She thinks it’s / they’re + tính từ.

  • What does he think of Mui Ne Beach? – He thinks it’s beautiful.
  • What does she think of Huong Pagoda? – She thinks it’s peaceful.

grammar.title: Hỏi khoảng cách giữa hai nơi
grammar.html:
How far is it from + địa điểm 1 + to + địa điểm 2? – It’s about … kilometres.

  • How far is it from Da Nang to Hoi An? – It’s about twenty-nine kilometres.

exercises.passage: Quang Ninh is a province in the north of Vietnam. It’s famous for Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Ha Long Bay has thousands of limestone islands and caves. You can take a boat trip to visit these islands and caves. It’s about a 160 kilometres from Hanoi to Ha Long Bay. You can get there by coach. Besides Ha Long Bay, there are many other interesting places to visit in Quang Ninh. You can go swimming, sunbathing, and playing beach games on the beautiful beaches of Tuan Chau Island. If you love nature, you can visit Yen Tu Mountain, a sacred place for Buddhists. For those who enjoy adventure, you can go hiking or kayaking. Quang Ninh is a beautiful and fantastic place to visit if you want to enjoy the natural beauty of Vietnam.
